description: A vitals dashboard for a Raspberry Pi 5 with an optional AI HAT+ 2: a terminal dashboard and a verb-oriented command line over the same collectors, so each readout (CPU, memory, temperatures, throttling, fan, disk, network) is also a scriptable report of one value and its unit, with JSONL recording for comparing runs.
name: rptop
softwareSuggestions: vcgencmd (libraspberrypi-bin), for the PMIC temperature, the core voltage and throttling
A C compiler (GCC or Clang) for the Hailo temperature
jq, zip and the GitHub CLI (gh), to run make check-release, make release and release.bash
releaseNotes: First release. A vitals dashboard and scriptable reporter for a Raspberry Pi 5 with an optional AI HAT+ 2: a terminal dashboard (bare rptop; keys q r R m p ?; options -interval, -warn-temp, -crit-temp, -out; no configuration file), reading verbs temp, cpu, mem, fan, volts, disk, net, throttle and list with -n, -j, -above and -below and the workspace exit codes, and JSONL recording (rptop record, or r in the dashboard) with a meta line, samples, markers and a meta_end line, a free-space guard and flat element names (DR-0003). The Hailo temperature is read in process through libhailort behind the hailo build tag (HailoRT >= 5.4.0). Linux arm64 on a Raspberry Pi 5 only.
